canonical.title: IT Conferences and Tech Events in Chengdu

siblings.title: Things to do in Chengdu
siblings.summary: A two-day Chengdu plan built around an early panda visit, walkable old-town streets, hotpot-and-teahouse culture, and a free evening for the Michelin dinner.

siblings.title: Michelin 2 and 3-star restaurants in Chengdu
siblings.summary: Chengdu has two Michelin 2-star restaurants and no 3-stars: Yu Zhi Lan for elevated Sichuan cuisine in an intimate chef-owned house, and Xin Rong Ji for luxury Taizhou seafood in a modern financial center.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events in Chengdu
siblings.summary: Chengdu's tech calendar peaks in April (C3 Security + China Network Audio-Visual Conference) and July (electronics expos); primarily Chinese-language industry events with real AI and cybersecurity depth.
